title: Aria
identity: Reger’s Aria, Op. 103a No. 3, is a transcription by Trent Kynaston for alto saxophone with piano or organ, Advance Music 7056. It adapts the third movement of Reger’s Suite in A minor, Op. 103a, for violin and piano.

evidence.claim: Alfred publisher listing identifies Kynaston’s alto saxophone transcription of Reger Op. 103a No. 3 and the piano/organ accompaniment options.

Chandos booklet identifies Reger’s Suite Op. 103a as a work for violin and piano; Aria is its third movement. This supports the source instrumentation, not the saxophone transcription’s written range.
evidence.source_name: Chandos Records booklet, Complete Works for Violin & Piano

review_focus: Inference: compare Kynaston’s saxophone transcription with the violin source for breath grouping, bow-articulation translation, and register; no notation from the saxophone edition was inspected.
collection_flag: Transcription of a movement from Reger’s violin-and-piano suite; piano/organ saxophone versions are available. The source identifies no intended age group.

score_links.description: Publisher/work listing; no notation preview inspected.
